items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: that was Paul Gaten, you understand? Paul Gaten started with a trio over there

ctx.x: Well I'll call you later about it, I'll phone you up and you can phone me. Anyway, what about other streets like Jackson Avenue, is much happening there?

No, you see after the dewdrops started, Buddy Charles went in there with him and Mr. Kimball and a couple of more places, and the Robin Hood started, that was Paul Gaten, you understand? Paul Gaten started with a trio over there, you understand? And then things just as a standstill with, you know, those group combos, out of town attraction, nothing else happened. Well I was swinging with my band, everywhere. I was playing Creole Fiesta, you know, in different, out of the lake and down in Beerus, you understand?…
Was there much on St. Charles Avenue?
